mutations.name: fr3-implementer-invalid-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Remove the invalid-implementer refusal so an invalid author falls through.
mutations.find:
if [ -n "$INVALID_RECORD" ]; then
  KEY=$(_pct_decode "${INVALID_RECORD%%,*}")
  FILE=${INVALID_RECORD#*,}; FILE=${FILE#*,}; FILE=$(_pct_decode "${FILE%%,*}")
  VALUE=${INVALID_RECORD#*,}; VALUE=${VALUE#*,}; VALUE=${VALUE#*,}; VALUE=${VALUE%%,*}
  VALUE=$(_pct_decode "${VALUE#invalid:}")
  _refuse implementer-invalid "implementer=$VALUE is not valid (valid: codex|agy|null) — refusing the write, fail-closed.
  Fix it: python3 ~/.claude/skills/h-mad/scripts/h_mad_state_write.py --feature $KEY --set implementer=codex|agy|null \"$FILE\""
fi

mutations.name: fr3-invalid-scan-first-record-only
mutations._mechanism: Inspect invalid authors only in the first record; a later invalid record must still outrank a peer.

mutations.name: fr3-agy-arm-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Remove the agy refusal arm so a resolved agy author falls through.
mutations.find:
agy)
      _refuse agy-authorship "Phase 5 implementation must be authored by agy, not Claude.
Dispatch this module to agy: hmad-dispatch exec agy <promptfile>  (stage it with h_mad_assemble_tdd.py --agent agy).
agy looks available (agy on PATH). If it is out of quota, record it —
  python3 ~/.claude/skills/h-mad/scripts/h_mad_state_write.py --feature $PEER_KEY --set agy_status=exhausted \"$PEER_FILE\"
then Claude may author the fallback (still test-first). Or export HMAD_AGY_UNAVAILABLE=1 for a one-off.
Use h_mad_tdd_judge.py implementer to see who resolves." ;;

mutations.name: fr3-peers-out-alternative-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Reject the peers-out author by removing its grammar alternative.

mutations.name: wire1-author-not-from-resolver
mutations._mechanism: Wire cut: hard-code codex with the resolver left intact instead of propagating its result.

mutations.name: wire2-hook-rederives-from-env
mutations._mechanism: Wire cut: rederive authorship from the environment and codex executable instead of reading the state author.
mutations.replace:
if [ -z "${HMAD_CODEX_UNAVAILABLE:-}" ] && [ "$ESCAPE" = no ] && command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        author=codex
      else
        author=peers-out
      fi

mutations.name: wire2-every-author-is-a-peer
mutations._mechanism: Converse: force the first record to select codex whatever its author, unconditionally reaching codex-authorship.
